acquisition method: We optimized multiple reaction monitoring (MRM) parameters via flow injection analysis
alkylation reagent: alkylated with 11 mM iodoacetamide in the dark at room temperature for 15 min.
alkylation concentration: alkylated with 11 mM iodoacetamide in the dark at room temperature for 15 min.
cleavage agent: Trypsin digestion was performed at a 1:50 enzyme-to-protein ratio overnight.
enrichment method: incubated with succinyl-lysine-specific resin (PTM-402, PTM Bio) overnight at 4 °C on a rotator.
instrument: Mass spectrometric analysis was conducted using an AB SCIEX 6500 QTRAP+ triple quadrupole mass spectrometer equipped with an ESI interface.
ionization type: mixed with the effluent before entering the electrospray ionization (ESI) source at a flow rate of 0.15 ml/min.
labeling: Label-free quantification was employed, maintaining identification and peptide-spectrum match FDRs at 1%.
reduction reagent: reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol at 56 °C for 30 min
reduction concentration: reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol at 56 °C for 30 min
